rationale.complete: Round 1 done: synthetic validation (rerun with the amended estimator), dated predictions, 13 per-period folders plus NE10 and the undocumented 08-20 nudger stop, scorecard, confirmatory script written and dry-run. Holdout not run; only one powered (short-pause) period.
rationale.faithfulness: In G51 the demon bookkeeping beats its nulls. Information is above the permutation null, the response is heterogeneous (R0 rejected) and the efficiency is well below 1 (R1 rejected). The predicted information magnitude and agent-blindness failed, and P4 failed as worded (negative value of information among gates, a stronger inefficiency). The response pattern reverses in the long-pause periods. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1; no holdout.
rationale.usefulness: A concrete nudge policy (once per pause chain at k = 2-3, only during pauses; x2.3 work per nudge) with a Kolchinsky-style efficiency audit, but counterfactual from logs, one powered period (G51), not holdout-tested, and small stakes (~1% of activity). Calibrated to parity with H05/H30.

one_line: The auto-nudger buys 1.45 active min per nudge with 1.4 bits of state but spends them on the deepest traps; nudging once, early in a pause chain, would roughly double to triple the work per nudge.
